name: pos-print-agent
description: Lightweight Windows POS Direct Thermal Print Agent for ESC/POS & Label Printing

scripts.build: esbuild server.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/bundle.js && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && powershell -Command "Copy-Item (Get-Command node).Source dist/print-agent.exe -Force" && postject dist/print-agent.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2

author: Subul POS
